items.title: Houthis, Saudis exchange strikes on airports as Mideast conflict intensifies
items.description: The Iran-backed Houthis in Yemen accuse Saudi Arabia of striking the rebel-held airport in Sanaa. This accusation comes amid escalating clashes between the Houthis and Saudi-backed forces.

items.title: Saudi Arabia weighs response after Houthi attack on Riyadh, deadliest in a decade
items.description: A missile attack on the Saudi capital's international airport, launched from Houthi-controlled territory in Yemen, killed at least 12 people and injured 309 on Saturday, including a French national.

items.title: Saudi Arabia vows response over Houthi ‘war crime’ attack on Riyadh airport
items.description: A Houthi attack on Riyadh airport killed at least 12 people and injured more than 300.

items.title: Russian Attack on Ukrainian City Kills 20, a Day After Trump Eases Diesel Sanctions on Moscow
items.description: The Ukrainian President offered some of his sharpest criticism of Donald Trump after this week's third mass-casualty Russian attack.

items.title: Drone strike by Sudan paramilitary kills 41 near Ethiopian border, rights group says
items.description: Eight children are said to be among those killed by the strike, which hit a gathering of displaced people.

items.title: Photos: What a year of ceasefire in Gaza looks like
items.description: It has been one year since Hamas released the remaining Israeli hostages and President Trump promised an end to the war, but Palestinians say the past 12 months have been a ceasefire in name only.

items.title: Trump Makes Deal With Putin On Diesel Exports. Ukraine Calls It A 'Gift'
items.description: US President Donald Trump said he reached an agreement with President Vladimir Putin to temporarily ease sanctions on Russian diesel exports, a move Ukraine immediately criticized as a "gift" to the Kremlin.

items.title: Eritrean troops in Ethiopia raise fears of a regional war
items.description: Ethiopia and Eritrea are trading blame for confrontations in Tigray amid international calls for restraint. Their respective allies have the potential to catapult the conflict into a regional war.
